title: Pre-push lint gate for decider close-records (closes the LLM-bypass of PROP-059's verification_pattern requirement)
author: tinker (DIRECTIVE-20260603-001, run tinker-2026-06-03T05-03)
source_finding: DIRECTIVE-20260603-001 + ISS-2519 (integrity-2026-06-03T02-00 Mech-A-bypass audit found 23 post-cutoff decider-driven close-records lacking verification_pattern AND audit_grandfathered).

problem.summary: PROP-059 (2026-05-25) established the rule: every decider-self-apply* close must carry a non-empty verification_pattern, OR be explicitly grandfathered. The rule is enforced as: (a) prompt-level FORBIDDEN language at write sites; (b) daily integrity audit (structure-integrity.md Step 7h) that flags violators. Despite (a) and (b), the LLM keeps bypassing the rule. Between 2026-05-26 and 2026-06-02 the LLM accumulated 23 violations across 14 distinct fixed_by paths — all custom inline strings (e.g. 'decider-self-apply-EXP-450-H1-wuhan-removed', 'decider-selfapply-prev-run-571a3d6', 'decider-archive-terminal-exps') that the prompt's canonical template doesn't produce. The 23 violations were committed to origin/main and survived ~10 days before integrity caught them.
problem.root_cause: PROP-059's enforcement is asynchronous (next-day integrity audit). The LLM's failure mode is improvising the close-record inline rather than copy-pasting the canonical Step 1 template — which produces a custom fixed_by string AND drops the verification_pattern field as a single forgetting-action. Prompt-level FORBIDDEN language has not stopped this; the LLM reads the discipline, agrees with it, then narrates a close-record that doesn't follow it. The only reliable defense is a synchronous, machine-enforced gate at push time.
problem.smoking_gun: ISS-2471 was the prior tracking ISS for 6 violations, and ISS-2471 was ITSELF closed via 'decider-verification-batch' without a verification_pattern. The bypass-of-bypass-tracking is direct evidence that prompt-only enforcement cannot stop this class of LLM error.

category_a_forgot_verification_pattern.fix_class: (a) — add verification_pattern via canonical Step 1 template. LLM bypass; needs synchronous gate.
category_a_forgot_verification_pattern.future_fix: PROP-076 pre-push lint gate refuses to push these. LLM must either (i) follow canonical template, or (ii) explicitly grandfather.

paths: decider-archive-terminal-exps (1 ISS: 2474 — bulk cleanup of terminated EXPs)
decider-verified-H7-already-1677 (1 ISS: 2514 — verification-only close, no patch applied)
category_b_designed_bulk_close.fix_class: (b) — design-intentional. Bulk close paths and verification-only closes don't have a per-entry fingerprint. Use audit_grandfathered with reason.
category_b_designed_bulk_close.future_fix: PROP-076 lint accepts audit_grandfathered as a valid alternative to verification_pattern. Decider's prompt now documents this explicitly (decider-patches-and-selfapply.md L595).

category_c_empty_string.note: No occurrences of empty-string verification_pattern (vs absent); the failure mode is uniformly omission.

change_1_lint_script.description: Pre-push lint that diffs local HEAD's closed-issues.json against origin/main, then applies the Mech-A-bypass filter from structure-integrity.md Step 7h to every newly-added entry. Exit 1 with the violating IDs printed. Same filter logic as the daily integrity audit, but synchronous at push time.

change_2_pre_push_block_invokes_lint.location: monitor/prompts/reference/decider-patches-and-selfapply.md (after existing PRE-PUSH GATE block, before `git push origin main` line; was L412, now L413)
change_2_pre_push_block_invokes_lint.description: Add `if ! node monitor/scripts/lint-close-records.js; then exit 1; fi` wrapped block. Aborts the push if lint fails. Reuses the same shell pattern as the existing integrity gate. ~18 lines.

change_3_prompt_pointer_to_pro_076.description: Add ~1 sentence to each existing PROP-059 paragraph pointing at the new lint gate. Makes the synchronous enforcement visible from every documentation site that mentions the rule.

change_4_retroactive_annotation_of_the_2.approach: Step 6a (operator-preferred for speed): bulk audit_grandfathered=true on all 23 with reason='PROP-076 pre-pre-push-gate bypass; fix-from-context inferred per closure_reason field'
change_4_retroactive_annotation_of_the_2.rationale: These 23 are sunk-cost audit-wise. The value is preventing future bypass. Per-entry fingerprint re-derivation (Step 6b) would take ~30 min for marginal value; the audit_grandfathered field documents that they were retroactively classified, not falsely verified.

change_5_close_iss_2519.description: ISS-2519 (the integrity finding that surfaced the 23) closed with closure_resolution citing PROP-076 + DIRECTIVE-20260603-001 + the retroactive annotation.

estimated_loc.under_self_apply_budget: yes (prompt-edit LOC 21 << 80; script LOC is not prompt-edit and is self-contained)

alternatives_considered.alt: Stronger prompt-only language (CAPS, bold, multiple repetitions)
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: PROP-059 already used FORBIDDEN + integrity audit + multiple reaffirmations across 3 prompt files. The LLM still bypassed. Discipline-by-language has hit its ceiling for this failure mode.

alternatives_considered.alt: Make audit_grandfathered field require operator-only writes
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The directive Step 3 fix direction (b) explicitly allows tinker / decider to set audit_grandfathered with a reason. Operator-only would block legitimate bulk-close paths until operator intervention; the field's value is documenting intent, not requiring operator gatekeeping.

alternatives_considered.alt: Block all status='fixed' writes; require manual operator promotion from fixed-pending-verification
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Already considered and rejected in PROP-059 alternatives (would multiply operator-touches per close).

alternatives_considered.alt: Per-entry fingerprint re-derivation for the 23 violations (Step 6b instead of 6a)
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Operator preference: Step 6a for speed. Per-entry re-derivation is ~30 min of LLM-thinking for marginal audit value (vs the audit_grandfathered field which documents the same provenance more compactly).

alternatives_considered.alt: Git pre-commit hook instead of pre-push prompt invocation
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Git hooks must be installed per-clone. Scheduled agents clone fresh each run; the hook would need to be `git config core.hooksPath` plus a committed hooks directory, which is more moving parts than calling the lint script directly from the existing PRE-PUSH GATE block. The prompt-driven invocation reuses existing pattern.

counter_considerations.what_if_decider_can't_construct_verifica: Per change_3, the prompt now documents the audit_grandfathered escape valve explicitly. Decider should set audit_grandfathered='<reason>' rather than ship a bare close-record. The lint script accepts either field.
counter_considerations.what_if_the_lint_script_itself_has_a_bug: The script is 123 lines of straightforward stream-process logic. The bug class is bounded: false positive (refuses legitimate push) → operator notices via daily integrity report's lack of new closures and unblocks. False negative (silently allows a violation) → the daily integrity audit (PROP-059 change_2) still fires the next morning, identical to the pre-PROP-076 baseline. The lint is additive, not replacing, integrity's check.
counter_considerations.what_about_operator_direct_pushes_with_b: OBE substring filter excludes operator-direct, burndown, sweep, wontfix, -OBE-, EXP-integrated, exp-integrated — these are recognized non-decider paths. Operator pushing 'fixed_by: operator-direct-PROP-XXX-completion' is unaffected.
counter_considerations.what_if_a_close_path_uses_a_fixed_by_out: Set audit_grandfathered='<reason>' to bypass the lint. Future PROP-NNN could narrow the OBE allowlist if a pattern emerges.
